name: Kuji (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kuji city emblem in green and blue: a disc divided green above and blue below with a white leaf and wave.
history: Municipal flag of Kuji, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 6 March 2006.

features.role: Kuji city emblem — a disc divided green above and blue below with a white leaf and wave
